# **📝 List of Contents** 📍Own your collection management with CLO-SET [Line Sheet,](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) including everything from Garment Thumbnail to Sales Channel and Price information. **![Line_sheet_-_List_Mode_4x.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777844657305)** 1. Upload Content(s) 2. Viewing Line Sheet 3. Info by Content 4. Info by Colorway 5. Customizing Fields # **📓 Details** **1\. Upload Content(s)** --- * Start by uploading the Contents to be displayed in the Line Sheet. Click '+' from your dashboard * Find further instructions on [how to upload](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303166737305) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777844800665) **2\. Line Sheet Beta**[**(Full Line Sheet Guide)**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) --- * Line Sheet is available on multiple space levels, from Workroom and Assortment to Brand * Enter the space, and click Line Sheet Beta icon on the top right corner * The list of Contents to be displayed on the Line Sheet will vary depending on which [space](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) you started. To view all Contents within a Brand, you must access Line Sheet from that Brand space ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777854277657) * In Line Sheet, ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845221017) 1. **Path** : displays which space you are viewing, and the location of the space 2. **Viewing** **Mode** : switch between list and thumbnail mode to view the Line Sheet 3. **Table** **Fields** : fields may be editable on a Colorway or Content level * Find the detailed guideline on [**Line Sheet Table Fields**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) _**💡 Notes**_ > Line sheet Thumbnail Mode
> > ![Screenshot_20221101_020628.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54993109060249) **3\. Info by Content** --- * Fields listed below are editable **by Content**(not editable for each Colorway) * [What is Content?](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303145393305) Editable by **Content** | * Content No. * Content Name * Workflow * Category * Material Composition * Tag * Description * Customer Type * Product Manager | ![editableCont1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845384089) ![editableCont2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845597593) ---|---|--- **4\. Info by Colorway** --- * Fields listed below are editable **by Colorway** Editable by **Colorway** | * Colorway * Status * Carryover * Quantity * Retail Intro Date * Retail Exit Date * Development Cost * Price * Sales Channel * Store Type * Store Name * Remark | ![editableCol1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845796249) ![editableCol2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846070809) ---|---|--- **5\. Customizing Fields** --- ### 1) [Content Information](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) * Selective fields in Line Sheet are auto-filled based on the Content Information * Applicable: Content No / Content Name / [Workflow](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) / [Category](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049) / Tags * [Fill in Content details](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) such as Workflow, Category, and Tags to effectively manage Content data * Please note: Changes made on Line Sheet will **NOT** be reflected back to the Content page ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846347929) ### 2) Company Settings > Line Sheet * Selective fields are customizable for each [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) in CLO-SET * **Applicable** : Category / Workflow / Status / Sales Channel / Store Type * Enter Company > click Settings icon at the top left > click Line Sheet ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846511513) * Select the field to customize, and add/edit/delete fields to be used throughout the Comapny * Enter 'Category' tab to customize Category * Enter 'Content' tab to customize Workflow * Enter 'Line Sheet' tab to customize Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777856032793)

Developer Page | | Create CLO-SET API token and trigger for your Group. **Details** ### 1) Subscription Information ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778533567385) * Find subscription information including Plan type, measurement period, next billing date, estimated billing amount, and payment method of your Group * Estimated Billing Amunt: All billing amounts are confirmed on the last day of your subscription, reflecting any changes in number of users within the Group. title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Construction
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732942489) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677355929) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732944153) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732944921) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- The Construction tab displays auto-generated markers and allows construction annotation for all Content Types that have been pre-set in CLO3D. CLO-SET Construction is integrated with all the materials, trims, and even sewing methods of the 3D garment made in CLO3D. * Data Sync from CLO3D BOM * Flexible modification, addition, and deletion of markers and their position * Easy-to-use annotation tools for texts and drawings * Availability of version updates as well as history tracking * Communicate with your partners, Share ideas, and Make final decisions for your outfits. ### 2\. How-To #### _Permission_ * * Admins: able to Edit and Delete others’ comments and annotations * Collaborators and Editors: able to Edit and Delete mine only ![construction_page_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732945177) #### ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.54.09_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732945561)_Content Type Panel_ Add Pages for new Content Type 1. Click the ![AddPageIcon.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732946201)button. 2. Select a Content Type Reorder Pages 1. Drag and Drop the Page as you would like. 2. Cover cannot be reordered. Delete & Duplicate Click on the ![dotdotdot.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677358617) and Duplicate or Delete as you wish. ![leftpanel.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732946969) #### ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.53.49_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677359385)_Construction Viewer &![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.54.56_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732947225)Construction/Comment Panel_ ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-01_at_5.09.25_PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677359897) To **Edit View Point** , click on the left icon to zoom in and zoom out and turn the camera with right click. * Rotation * Zoom In/Out * Camera Point * Keyboard Shortcuts To **Edit Drawing** , click on the right icon to make annotation drawings and add or delete markers. Please refer to the details of each feature from the left side of the Annotation Tool Bar. ![annotationToolBar.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732947737) * ![pic.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677360409) Attach Image \- After clicking on the viewer window, the File Directory will appear. * ![move.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732948889) Click \- You can move and adjust around other annotations that you have already created. * ![input_text.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732949273) Input Text * ![pen.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732949785) Pen * ![straightline.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732951065) Straight Line * ![curvedLine.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732951705) Curved Line * ![oneArrow.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732952473) One-sided Arrow * ![circle.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677363737) Circle * ![square.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732954265) Square * ![penColor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677364761) Toolpen Color * ![thickness.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677366169) Toolpen Thickness ![markerToolBar.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732955673) You can Add and Delete markers from the tool bar on the bottom of the 3D Viewer Window. ### ### **Examples** ![example2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368089)![example1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368473) ### 3\. Page Types 1. Cover Page ![cover.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368857) * Viewer panel shows the ‘front’ and the ‘back’ images that are generated when saving the garment as Zpac and Zprj * Construction Version shows the list of history versions as well as the Current Version. * Page Name is named default as Cover, and it can be modified. 2. Pattern Page ![Pattern.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677369753) * Page Name is named default as Pattern, and it can be modified. * The markers of Pattern start from P1, using the ‘P’ prefix from Pattern. * The Pattern Panel displays the parts of the Patterns used for each Fabric from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Pattern list is identical to the order of the Pattern from CLO3D. * The construction markers of Pattern _**cannot be added or deleted.**_ * On the bottom right corner of the viewer window, there is a Pattern Layout, which can be clicked to view. 3. Fabric Page ![fabricPage.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677370393) * Page Name is named default as Fabric, and it can be modified. * The markers of Fabric start from F1, using the ‘F’ prefix from Fabric. * The Fabric Panel displays the names of the Fabric used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Fabric list is identical to the order of the Fabric from CLO3D. 4. Graphic Page * Page Name is named default as Graphic, and it can be modified. * The markers of Graphic start from G1, using the ‘G’ prefix from Graphic. * The Graphic Panel displays the names of the Graphic used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Graphic list is identical to the order of the Graphic from CLO3D. 5. Button Head Page * Page Name is named default as Button Head, and it can be modified. * The markers of Button Head start from B1, using the ‘B’ prefix from **B** utton Head. * The Button Head Panel displays the names of the Button Head used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Button Head list is identical to the order of the Button Head from CLO3D. * The count of Button Head is shown inside the parenthesis. ![buttonHead.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732957849) 6. Button Hole Page * Page Name is named default as Button Hole, and it can be modified. * The markers of Button Hole start from H1, using the ‘H’ prefix from Button **H** ole. * The Button Hole Panel displays the names of the Button Hole used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Button Hole list is identical to the order of the Button Hole from CLO3D. * The count of Button Hole is shown inside the parenthesis. ![buttonHole.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677371417) 7. Zipper Page * Page Name is named default as Zipper, and it can be modified. * The markers of Zipper start from Z1, using the ‘Z’ prefix from Zipper. * The Zipper Panel displays the names of the Zipper used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Zipper list is identical to the order of the Zipper from CLO3D. * All parts of Zippers such as Zipper Puller, Zipper Slider, Zipper Teeth, Top Stopper, and Bottom Stopper, are shown in the Zipper Content Page. 8. Topstitch Page * Page Name is named default as Topstitch, and it can be modified. * The markers of Topstitch start from T1, using the ‘T’ prefix from Topstitch. * The Topstitch Panel displays the names of the Zipper used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Zipper list is identical to the order of the Zipper from CLO3D. 9. Etc. Page * Page Name is named default as Etc., and it can be modified. * The markers of Etc. start from E1, using the ‘E’ prefix from Etc. * The Etc. Panel displays the names of the Etc. items used from CLO3D, such as trm. obj, fbx, dae, glb, and others. 10. Blank Page * Page Name is named default as New Page, and it can be modified. * Markers are not created in Blank Page. * This Page is for flexible usage of annotations. ### ### 4\. Construction Versions * Web Tech Pack is created for each individual content in CLO-SET. * Web Tech Pack data is based on the Version Updates. * The data shown in Construction is the data of the ‘Current’ Version’s zpac, or zprj file. * The versions that have been ‘Version Updated’ on WTP are shown in Construction. * For example, ContentA has 5 versions. And, Version 1, 3, 5 has only been Version Updated in WTP, then the Construction also only shows Version 1, 3, 5. * Editing can only be done in the ‘Current Version’. The past versions are View Only. **![construction_page.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732959257)**
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide users with an integrated platform for managing and annotating 3D garment tech packs, allowing for real-time collaboration and seamless updates from CLO3D data.

title: Create Assortment
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET [Assortment](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168765593) is the ultimate tool for showcasing your entire collection. 1. Enter workroom 2. Create Assortment 3. Review Assortment 4. Mix & Match # **📓 Details** **1\. Enter workroom** --- In the left menu pane, follow these steps: 1. Click the **Browse** icon. 2. Select **Company** at the top of the menu tree. 3. Double-click **Brand** in the main screen. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393652249) 4. Double-click the **Season** in the Brand space.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372340633) 5. Double-click the **Workroom** in the Season space.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393655065) 6. You can view content in the **Workroom.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393655833) **2\. Create Assortment** --- * Select the Content(s) to move, and click _**Add to Assortment**_. For a single item, click the ⋯ (More) button and choose _**Add to Assortment**_ ; For multiple items, hold Ctrl/Cmd and click _**Assortment**_ from **the floating menu**. * Select an Assortment room to use on the space tree, or create new Assortment. When creating a new Assortment, enter a name on the blank and click _Next_. * All Contents must be uploaded in Workroom first, to be moved to Assortments * User must be Admin or Collaborator to add Content to Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393656217) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372349081) ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372350745) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989679943705) _**💡 Note**_ > **You can also create Assortment in season page**
> > 1\. Click ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989696559257) icon from the 'Season' Space. > 2\. Enter Assortment name and click 'CONFIRM' button. **3\. Review Assortment** --- * Enter the Assortment to start * Adjust the layout with the sizing menu, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372352537) * Switch View Mode option, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** _The 3D view mode cannot be changed in bulk from the dropdown menu._ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372353561) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393664153) * Switch View By options to adjust the Assortment layout _\- View By**Content** : displays 1 _[_default Colorway thumbnail_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129) _of each Content_ _\- View By**Colorway** : displays each Colorway as a separate image_ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372356633) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372357529) * Active the **'Synchronized' camera** at the top menu bar, and hover over any Content to open the Turntable bar. Click the Turntable bar and move the mouse to rotate the designs together ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372357913) * To **change the order** of Content(s), click 'Change Order" icon at the menu bar. Click & drag the Contents to adjust the order, and click 'Save As New Order' button. Type in the name of the order, and click 'Save' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372358809) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776354102553) * Click the **Eye icon** at the bottom of the content and turn off **Show Hidden Colorway** at the top menu bar to view only active colorways, excluding those with the Eye icon disabled. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393670681) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372367385) * You can also click the **Pin icon** to select colorways, then click the **Excel button** at the top to download only the pinned colorways as an Excel file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393673241)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989859660569) * Click **Mix & Match** in the top-right corner to freely combine multiple garments for review. Click **Create a Virtual Showroom** to add garments to a showroom space and display them. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393675161) _**💡 Note**_ > * **You can add Style Content to Assortment in Assortment page** > 1\. Click ![blobid1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989679944601) icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. > 2\. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT
> > > ![assortment.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989696561049)
> > * When content is deleted from the Workroom, it will appear as an unavailable thumbnail in the Assortment.
> > > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54986851144729)
> > * Colorways created in the **Configurator** are displayed in the **Assortment Room**. > When a newer version is available, a **red dot indicator** appears next to the content, allowing Editors (or higher) to update to the latest version, while Viewers can see the indicator without access to the update action.
> ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989852711193) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989859663513) > ---|--- **4\. Mix & Match Contents** --- [Mix & Match](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) the Contents to review the full outfit #### **1) How to use Mix &Match** 1\. Move the Content you want to Mix&Match to the same Assortment room *You can only select the 3D Contents in the same Assortment room from where you entered the Mix&Match page. 2\. Multi-select the contents by clicking the check box at the top-left side of the respective content 3\. Click the ‘MIX AND MATCH’ Icon on the right top 4\. Load your items by drag-and-dropping into the viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550741273)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550749721) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511745561) ### #### **2) Mixing & Matching Garments** * Drag and drop selected garments into the Mix & Match view * Combine any garments freely without category restrictions * Adjust garment placement to explore different outfit combinations ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550758169)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550760985) #### **3) Saving a Scene** * Save the final outfit combination as a **scene** * Saved scenes can be used for later review, feedback, or collaboration ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511752089)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511756313) #### **4) Tips** * We recommend using contents that are created with consistent avatars and poses for more promising outcomes. * You can freely add and combine multiple garments to explore different outfit variations.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide for users on how to effectively showcase and manage their clothing collections through the CLO-SET Assortment tool, including steps for creating, reviewing, and mixing outfits.

Click to switch viewer modes! ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778027716377) ✔️ By Viewer Mode **2D** | **3D** | **Render** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038351641) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038486681) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778021096345) *When viewing in Render mode, selecting a colorway OUTSIDE the viewer will NOT be reflected. *Colorway list is from the original Zprj file. Select the desired 3D contents and activate 3D Viewers by clicking the 'Viewer' button in the 3D window. 2. When the 3D viewer has been activated, turn on the Synchronized Camera mode by clicking the 'Synchronized' button on the top of the 3D contents. 3. Now, you can review and control multiple 3D contents with the customized multiview at the same time. ※ Note: In accordance with the release of ‘Synchronized Camera’, ‘My bag’ Function will discontinue its service and be replaced from October 5, 2021. #### ✔️ Colorway Show&Hide **Show/Hide** button is available at the bottom of the content section. Please follow the link to find detailed guidelines on how to set up your Virtual Showroom. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 1.15.34 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778014153881) ### 5) Simple Mix & Match [Mix & Match](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) your Contents to review the full style. When a newer version is available, a **red dot indicator** appears next to the content, allowing Editors (or higher) to update to the latest version, while Viewers can see the indicator without access to the update action. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600635531801) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600626489625)

title: CLO-SET Thumbnail
content:
#### Content: Applicable to Content uploaded or updated on March 12th, 2024 and onward, or PDF files uploaded on July 9th, 2024 and onward. # **Objective** Understand the Thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET. 1. Default Colorway 2. Custom View 3. Thumbnail Types & Rules 4. Thumbnail Change 5. PDF Thumbnail # **Details** CLO-SET offers two different thumbnail options of content. When uploading 3D files to CLO-SET, users can select either the "**Default Colorway"** or the **"Custom View"** option. ### ### **1) Default Colorway** **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778235562649)** * CLO-SET Thumbnails are created based on the original file. Starting Mar 2024, CLO-SET thumbnails will be synced with the Default Colorway in CLO3D. * '**Deafult Colorway** ' is the selected Colorway at the time of saving the file in CLO3D. * To change the 'Deafult Colorway' used in CLO-SET, you may upload a new Version or 'Create New Version' ### **2) Custom View** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686255641) * Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. CLO-SET, supports thumbnail images and turntable images based on the Custom View. Link to set [Custom View](https://clo3d.zendesk.com/knowledge/editor/01JWB42WYFJTD6VSN6JS0ECPJP/en-us?brand_id=44407677825689&section_id=44750293195417) in CLO-SET. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only
> > saved for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including
> > **Linesheet** , **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnails in CLO-SET. ### **3) Thumbnail Types & Rules** * ### Content Page There are 3 types of Thumbnail images on the Content Page. **[Important]** All Thumbnails within the Content Page will be based on the Default Colorway of the uploaded file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778259295897) * ### Workroom View **[Important]** Beginning March 2024, Workroom Thumbnail and Turntable will be based on the Default Colorway of the original file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778250198553) ![thumbnail3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286596121) * ### Assortment Assortment Thumbnail is shown based on the Default Colorway of latest version at the time Content was moved to the Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286769689) ### 3) Thumbnail Changes * ### Change Thumbnail * Thumbnail in Content Information tab * Thumbnail in Workroom view * Turntable will NOT be updated ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287073433) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778251183641) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287393561) * ### Version Update * Uploading a new [Version](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) will auto-update the Thumbnails in Content Page and Workroom. * To avoid the changes in Thumbnail, please activate 'Keep the current Thumbnail' option. ![Group 134.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686257817) * ### Create New Version * Creating a New Version will update all Thumbnails in Content Page & Workroom View. * Selected Colorway at the time of creating the new Version will replace the 'Default Colorway' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778272699801). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778294849945) * ### Delete Latest Version * * Deleting the Latest Version will NOT update the Thumbnails shown in Workroom or Content Page - Information tab. Thumbnail from the deleted version will be displayed. To change the Thumbnail, please upload a new Version or Create New Version. ### 4) PDF Thumbnail * When uploading a PDF file as a new Content or Version, CLO-SET will create a thumbnail based on the cover page of the uploaded PDF file. * Users can click the 'PDF preview' button on the viewer to load the preview of the full document. * If the 'keep current thumbnail' option is enabled, Thumbnail will not be updated on Content Info tab and Workroom page. * If the file is too large or cannot be opened due to error, a PDF icon will be displayed instead. * * Content Page Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778273168537) * * Workroom Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778295266329) > 💡 **Note:** Thumbnails on the Content Page can now be viewed in full screen. By clicking the **expand icon** located beneath the thumbnail, a new window will open, allowing to view a larger, clearer version of the image. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376979097) ### **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376984473)** ###
content_description: This webpage aims to provide users with a comprehensive understanding of thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET, detailing options for Default Colorway and Custom View for uploaded content.

title: Visual Board
content:
#### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774746252441)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774754697113)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774783276825)Editor # **Objective** Understand how to create/edit/share Visual Board in CLO-SET 1. What is Visual Board? 2. User Scenario 3. Create 4. Edit Mode * Utilizing 3D Assets * Edit Mode UI 5. Invite & Share 6. Export to PDF 7. Permission & Notification 8. Shortcut keys # **Details** ### **1) What is Visual Board?** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774771787033) Visual Board is a creation tool for showcasing your design using the 3D assets in CLO-SET. Users can now create Lookbooks or Moodboards with the 3D assets. * Create Lookbook, Moodboard, or Presentation with your Assets * Collaborate with your team online * Drag & Drop 3D assets to add 2D Images with a click ### 2) User Scenario ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774772003481) ### 3) Create Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor * From your dashboard, click on 'Workspace' > 'Visual Board' * Click '+' to create a new Visual Board * Enter the title and description, then click 'Create' * [Please Note] Only the creator of the Board & Group Admin will have access to the Board. Invite new members as Editors to the Board for collaboration. * Editors of the Group will NOT be automatically added to the Board. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54980929277337) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54980942560537) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54980929280281) ---|---|--- ### 4) Edit Mode Permission: Group Admin, Board Creator, Board Editor (directly shared from Board's Share tab) * Start editing the Board. You may use ALL assets you have access to within the Group. * Please note: only 1 user can edit the Board at a time. While 1 user is editing, others can view Slide Show or Comments. Slide Show will be based on the last saved version. * Make sure to click 'Save' once the work is complete. * Click 'Share' ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) to add Board Editors to grant edit access. * Group members will NOT be automatically added. You must add the user as Editor to each Board for collaboration. * [Important] When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. ### [Utilizing 3D Assets] * To add your Contents/Files on the board, start dragging & dropping the Content from the right pane to the slide. When adding the Content, you have an option to embed a link to 3D viewer, Content Page, or Customer URL. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54980942563993) 1. 1. **Add Images** : Select view(s) to add. * Zprj/Zpac files: Select from Thumbnail, Front, Left, Right, and Back view. * Other file types: Add Thumbnail image. 2. **Link (URL)** : Create hyperlink to the 3D Viewer, Content Page, or Custom URL to the image. 3. **Include Name & Colorway Name**: Insert the Content Name or Colorway Name as a text object 4. **Edit Toolbar:** add or edit components on/to your slide **Edit Toolbar** | **Bubble Toolbar** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819873689) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785684377) ### [Colorway Options] * Select 'By Colorway' to add Images of different Colorways. ![Screenshot 2024-04-04 at 3.44.25 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774761405849) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774800280601) * * By Content: displays [Default Colorway](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129) (last selected when saved in CLO software). * By Colorway: displays selected Colorway. * [Thumbnail](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129): customizable on the original Content Page. ### [Edit Mode UI] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785382425) 1. **Title** : Title of the Board. Click to make changes. 2. **Save, Slide Show, Exit** * Save: save the current version * Slide Show: preview and share slide show * [Coming Soon] Export the Board * Exit: leave edit mode. Changes will not be saved **3\. Share** * Edit Permission is unique for each Board. You must have Editor permission to the specific Board to make changes. Group Admin can access/edit/delete all Boards as a default. * Creator of the Board automatically has Editor permission to the Board * Add other members to the Board as Editors to collaborate. * Group members will NOT be automatically granted permission to edit the Board. Adding a new Editor to the Board will include the invitee as a Group member. **4\. Slide List** : add, duplicate, or delete each slide **5\. Edit Toolbar:** add or edit components on/to your slide **Edit Toolbar** | **Bubble Toolbar** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819873689) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785684377) > 💡 Notes: Drawing Curved Line
> > 1. **Click-to-Click-to-Click**
> 2. **Click, Hold, Drag and Release** (+Click for Curve)
> > 💡 Notes: Perfect Circle / Square
> > 1. Create the shape with holding **shift key**
> > > * Holding **Shift Key** while scaling helps maintain the aspect ratio **6-1. Available Color Palettes** * please note: custom palettes uploaded as color preset are not yet supported in Visual Board **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785839129) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774762696089) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774786337049) **6-2. Slide Background / Undo & Redo** * Background: Select the background color of each slide * Undo & Redo the edit action **7\. Search & Filter**: find the Asset within the Group, or select the Space to find the Content. **8\. Asset List** : Drag & Drop the Asset to the Board to add an Image. You can only use Assets you have permission to. **💡 Tips** **1\. Change Order** : Select the object(s) and right click to change the order. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774801962905) * **Single Select** : change the order of a single object. * Bring to front: bring the object to the very front of the slide * Bring forward: bring the object to move forward by 1 layer * Send to back: bring the object to the very back of the slide (excluding background) * Send backward: bring the object to move back by 1 layer * **Multi Select** : change the order of multiple objects together. Order among the selected objects will remain. * Bring to front: bring the objects selected the very front of the slide as a group * Send to back: bring the objects selected to the very back of the slide as a group (excluding background) **2\. Rotate & Flip **: All objects transformation “Rotate & Flip” available *** image, drawing (by pencil), line, shape, text (rotate only)** ![Group 137.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48033270018841) * Free Rotate (15 degree by each pitch) by Handle UI with a Selected Object * Multi select “rotate & flip” available![06 - Object Rotation.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48033297757465) **3\. Pen tool** : allows to draw precise lines and curves for more detailed visual expression * Draw both **straight lines and curves** using a single Pen Tool * Create more **precise and flexible shapes** for visual annotations and concept sketches * Edit shapes by adjusting points and curves for finer control ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819888025) **[Pen tool Key Features]** **1\. Flexible Shape Creation** 1. Draw straight lines by clicking points with Left Mouse Button (LMB) 2. Create curves by clicking, holding, and dragging with LMB 3. Close shapes to create filled areas **2\. Edit Mode** 1. **Enter/Exit** : Double-click (LMB) on any shape to enter Edit Mode 2. **Select and Move Points** : Click (LMB) to select and reposition individual anchor points 3. **Bezier Handle Editing** : Adjust curve handles (LMB) for precise curvature control 4. **Change Point Type** : Ctrl + LMB to toggle between corner and curve points. Click again to switch back. macOS: `Command + LMB` Windows: `Ctrl + LMB` 5. **Decouple Bezier Handles** : Alt + LMB for independent handle control (aligning them pairs them again) macOS: `Option + LMB` Windows: `Alt + LMB` 6. **Move Segments** : Select and drag segments (highlighted by two points) to adjust shapes 7. **Add Points** : Click anywhere on a segment to add a point. A snap guide will appear at the center of the segment for precise placement. 8. **Remove Points** : Select a point and press `Delete / Backspace` 9. **Multi-Select** : `Shift + LMB` to select multiple points simultaneously 10. **Delete Shape** : Select all points (or all except one) and press Backspace macOS: `Delete` Windows: `Backspace` ### 4) Invite & Share (Slide Show Mode) * **Add Editor** (Add Board Editor for collaboration) * Click the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) at the top-right corner to add Board Editors * Default: Only the Board Creator and Group Admin can edit. * Add new Editors to each Board to grant Edit permission. * [Important]: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774830525337) * **Share & Publish** (Share the slide show with external users) * From Slide Show mode, click on the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) at the top-right corner * **Restricted** : Only you and Can Edit member can access the slide show with link * **Publish** : Anyone with link can view the slide show ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774770667289) ### 6) Export to PDF ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774775546905) On the Edit page, you can now export the Visual Board to a PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774817739033) * Selected Page: only export the selected page (single slide) * All Pages: export the full Board (all slides) ### 7) Permission & Notification * Permission to Visual Board * Please note: Group members are NOT automatically granted access to all Boards. You must be added as an Editor to each Board to view/make changes to unpublished Boards. ![visualboardpermission.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774802983577) * Notification * Manage notifications regarding Visual Board on [My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) * Notification sent to: Group Admin, Board Creator, and Board Editors (anyone added to each Board with 'Can Edit' permission) ### 8) Shortcut Keys **Key** | **Details** ---|--- Ctrl/Command + z Ctrl/Command + y | Undo Redo Ctrl/Command + a | Select all objects Shift + h Shift + v | Flip (horizontal) Flip (vertical) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188804737305) v i t b l p c | Select Tool Image Tool Text Tool Pencil Tool Line Tool Pen Tool Shapes Tool [ Ctrl/Command + [ ] Ctrl/Command + ] | Bring to front Bring forward Send to back Send backward

content: ## 📝 **List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to manage user access and permissions in the Admin Console. * Access Admin Console * Search * Change Permission * Remove Access > ###### _Permission:![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778737061017) Group Admin, Group Operator_ # **📓 Details** **•Access Admin Console** --- 1\. Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com/) and click **Console** button from the left navigation menu. 2\. Only Group Admin can use the 'Space' filter. **3\. Search by content** * Click the toggle button in the **Content** section to switch it from **Off** to **On**. * Click **Select a Content** and choose the content you want to search for. * Confirm that the correct content is selected, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched users’ **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061567641) ### **•Change Permission** --- ##### **1\. content: # **Objective** Understand the CLO-SET Group structure. Understanding the Group structure and operation is an initial step in collaborating with your team using CLO-SET. 1. What is a 'Group'? 2. Pricing Plan 3. Group Hierarchy 4. Permission 5. Company Transfer 6. Leave a Group # **Details** ### 1) What is a ‘Group’? ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 11.19.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776072787097) When a new user signs up in CLO-SET, a new Group is created. Group is the highest level Space in CLO-SET, and within each Group are Spaces such as Company - Brnad - Line - Season etc. You may invite other teammates to your Group, or be invited to another user's Group for collaboration. CLO-SET operates on a Group level. That is, Structure, Permission, and Pricing Plan is determined per Group. ### ### 2) Pricing Plan ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.42.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776054299033) CLO-SET Pricing Plan is applied to each Group. You may check which Plan the Group is using on your dashboard. Please check out our Pricing Page to learn about different options. ### 3) Group Hierarchy ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.47.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090181913) CLO-SET Group consists of different Spaces in a hierarchy. Within each Group can be multiple Company, Brand, Line, Season, Workroom, and Assortment Spaces. You may invite or share each Space with your teammates. Learn more about creating Spaces [here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865). ### 4) Permission CLO-SET has a total of 5 Permission levels to provide for advanced security control options on your assets. Please check out this article to see different types of [Permissions](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Permission is also applicable to each Group. For example, you may be a Company Admin within 1 Group, but a Viewer on another Group. ### 5) Company Transfer * Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776081893657) Group Admin / Company Admin Company Transfer allows users to transfer Company between different Groups. This can be an alternative option when your Group Admin changed and you need to change the Group Admin to a different account. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.03.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776071175833) 1\. Go to 'Company Setting'. 2\. Click 'Company Transfer' and enter the Admin email of the recipient Group. 3\. Admin of the recipient Group must accept the request to complete the transfer. Log in to CLO-SET to accept. * * Please be noted that the RECIPIENT of the Company must be on Premium Plan. ### 6) Leave a Group * Permission: Company Admin / Collaborator / Editor / Viewer / Group Operator Members of the Group can choose to leave a Group without further actions from Admin. * Select the Group from the drop-down menu at the top left corner. * Go to 'Workspace' or 'Console' tab on the left. (Menu options may differ based on your permission) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090704025) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776105889177) * Click 'Leave This Group' at the bottom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776106032153) * Confirm the action by clicking 'OK'. Make sure to check the name of the Group you are leaving. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776082826265) * Upon leaving the Group, Group Admin and Group Operator will receive notifications. *Group Admin cannot leave the Group. *Once you click 'OK', you may NOT undo the action. Please reach out to Group Admin to regain access. ### 🔔 Policy Update (2026.01.27) : Group Activation for New Users Joining via Invite or Share **New users** who sign up for CLO-SET **via a Group invitation or shared content** will have their personal Group **deactivated by default**. If needed, users can activate their own Group by selecting **Create My Group** from the Group Switcher. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600755328793) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54606352390041)
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the CLO-SET Group structure and its functionalities to facilitate effective collaboration within your team.

title: Simple Mix & Match
content: # **Objective** Mix & Match allows you to review outfit combinations by freely combining selected garments in a single view. You can start Mix & Match directly from the **Assortment Room** using selected contents. 1. How to start Mix & Match 2. Mixing & Matching Garments 3. Saving a Scene 4. Tips # **Details** ### 1) How to use Mix&Match 1\. Move the Content you want to Mix&Match to the same Assortment room *You can only select the 3D Contents in the same Assortment room from where you entered the Mix&Match page. 2\. Multi-select the contents by clicking the check box at the top-left side of the respective content 3\. Click the ‘MIX AND MATCH’ Icon on the right top 4\. Load your items by drag-and-dropping into the viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187131182489)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187131189785) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187131193625) ### ### 2) Mixing & Matching Garments * Drag and drop selected garments into the Mix & Match view * Combine any garments freely without category restrictions * Adjust garment placement to explore different outfit combinations ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187146016281)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187146018713) ### 3) Saving a Scene * Save the final outfit combination as a **scene** * Saved scenes can be used for later review, feedback, or collaboration ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187131199641)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54187131201049) ### 4) Tips * We recommend using contents that are created with consistent avatars and poses for more promising outcomes. * You can freely add and combine multiple garments to explore different outfit variations.
content_description: The Mix & Match page empowers users to creatively combine selected garments in a single view, facilitating the exploration and saving of unique outfit combinations directly from the Assortment Room.

title: Account Deletion & Subscription Cancellation
content:
**Q1 : How do I delete my account?** **A1 : There are two ways to delete your CLO-SET account.** You can either wait until your current subscription expires and then delete your account, or choose to cancel your subscription immediately and delete your account right away. **Note:** Once your account is deleted, all data will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered. * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to delete account on CLO-SET. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## **Details** #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1. Visit “My Page” from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) to start the account deletion process. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461458073) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "My Page". ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454111769) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454112281) > 💡 **Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller
> > on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete
> > the account directly. Please click **"Contact US"** button for further assistance. ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461460761) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. > 💡 **Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active only **after the end date**. #### ![mceclip6.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454119193) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ > 💡 **Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing. ![mceclip7.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461463705) 2\. Account will be deleted immediately after email verification and a short survey are completed. ![mceclip8.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461466521)![mceclip9.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461468185) * * * **Important Notes on Account Deletion** 1) Once deleted, the account cannot be recovered, and sign-in will no longer be possible on both the website and software. 2) After deletion, content and posts previously created will display the user name as follows: * If the email address is shown: **“Deleted Account”** will be displayed instead. * If the account name is shown: it will remain as **{account name}** , as in the case of CLO-SET. *
content_description: This web page provides clear instructions on how to delete your CLO-SET account, either after your subscription expires or immediately, along with important notes about data loss and account recovery.

title: Didn’t receive the verification email during sign-up?
content: **Q1: I am not receiving the verification email. What should I do?** **A1:** Double check the email address typed in. Make sure you do not have typos. **A2:** If you are using your company email, please contact your IT team for any firewall setups. The verification email may be blocked from your company's email server settings, even before reaching your spam inbox. **A3:** If you are still experiencing the issue, please [submit a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) for a manual verification process. **A4: Student Email** \- Some school domains block external emails. Please check if your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com) **A5: Gmail Account -** Mark incorrectly classified emails as Not spam. Go to your spam folder and open the email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com). Click on the 'Report not spam' button at the top. Gmail uses machine learning to recognize spam. So you need to mark CLO-SET emails as not spam manually to let Gmail learn your behavior. **Note :** Even if your email address has not been verified yet, you can still log in to CLO-SET. After logging in, you can complete the email verification process at any time again. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138028055193) * * * **Q2: I signed up using a Google account and did not see an email verification step. Is this an issue?** **A1:** No, this is not an issue. If you sign up using a Google account, your email address is automatically verified, so no additional email verification step is required. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138106505369)
content_description: This web page provides troubleshooting tips and guidance for users experiencing issues with email verification for their accounts.

title: How do I change my email address?
content: ## **Q1 : How can I change my email address?** **A1 :** Go to **My Page** and click **Change Email** to update your email address. * * * **Q2 : I see a message saying that my email cannot be changed. Why is this happening?** **A2 :** There may be several reasons why you are unable to change your email address. Your issue may fall under one of the cases below. 1. **Email address already in use** 2. **Unable to change email** 3. **Account region mismatch** (*CLO / CLO-SET only) 4. **Email change will affect the plan type** (*CLO only) For detailed explanations and step-by-step solutions, please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) . * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. [Change Email vs. Email Switching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QNCTQSZMYFJFQ43ZPVV7T3) 2. [Ground Rules for Change Email](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#01J14B22H7ABR174MHJYQN61F6) 3. [Change Email Guide](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN98R7YZPTP1RMBQ3QSFP) * General Flow * Confirm License Info * Troubleshooting 4. [Change Email Implications](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN6FK48VSWVVB87JZJ82Y) 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | **VS** | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774805401) | ![emai switch.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773992217) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO & Marvelous Designer license information if any. Please find instructions below on the [Change Email Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577). * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO or Marvelous Designer license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) , [**CLO**](https://clo3d.com/accounts), or [**Marvelous Designer**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account) to start the change email process ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773993625) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773994393) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773995545) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773997977) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774811289)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774003737)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004121)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004377) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774006937) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the '[Email Switching](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577)' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for instructions. Note : #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * Additionally, please review what to consider when changing emails for each product: [CLO](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CONNECT](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CLO-SET](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ### [CLO] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. ### [Marvelous Designer] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. ### [CLO-SET / CONNECT] * **Billing Email Matching** The registered payment information on Stripe will NOT be updated automatically. To change the email address of your Stripe account, please visit Stripe (<https://stripe.com/>). * **Account Data** Users can continue accessing the Groups and uploaded files they have permission to. Please note that your account name will not be updated. To change your account name, please visit [https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount.](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [**Troubleshooting Guide**](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address, detailing the process, potential issues, and important implications associated with the change.
